title: ACSU-50 — Akka Classic Static Untimed Source-Grounded Candidate Catalog
disclaimer: Research catalog/adaptation plan, NOT 50 compiled runnable benchmarks. All normalized implementation/admission statuses PENDING. Includes snippets, library patterns and compositions, not 50 independent published programs. PRIMARY means prioritization, not verified tool compatibility.

scope.creation: All application actors explicitly created before processing release; no runtime child creation, respawn or resize
scope.time: No application clocks, sleep, timers, deadline, receive timeout or timed ask. External harness timeout is not model time.
scope.isolation: No mutable state shared across actors
scope.proof: Bounded sampled-trace conformance, not full bidirectional semantic equivalence
scope.execution_status: None of the 50 newly normalized cases has been implemented or executed in this research task

benchmarks.name: Echo
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: integer echo, sender identity, reply recipient
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Wrap raw primitive messages in named scalar messages; instantiate a fixed requester and echo actor. Do not copy the surrounding router test suite.

benchmarks.name: Key-Value Cache
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract Cache without its pool/router. Keep a finite string/key domain and expose full bounded map; Option replies and strings need explicit representation.

benchmarks.name: Parameterized Adder
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Lift nested DemoActor into a top-level Actor, keep the constructor constant, and wrap Int input/output. Do not instantiate DemoActorWrapper/SomeOtherActor.

benchmarks.name: Integer Calculator
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: two argument values and operation dispatch
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use CalculatorActor alone, no Lagom service. Restrict inputs to avoid overflow initially; later test signed Int boundaries with matching semantics.

benchmarks.name: Summing Accumulator
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: persistent scalar state and message order
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract SummingActor only. Exclude BehaviourAndState App's infinite Thread.sleep loop and the different SummingActorWithConstructor variant.

benchmarks.name: Finite Ping-Pong
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Replace Savina base wrapper with explicit Classic receive without changing message causality. Declare named actors in one bootstrap; map ActorRef-valued fields or gate them; audit exit behavior.

benchmarks.name: Counting
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: send 3 increment messages then read count
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Lift inherited process into explicit receive; fixed producer/counter refs and tiny N. Preserve source-specific ordering and completion protocol.

benchmarks.name: Fixed Fan-out Throughput Kernel
benchmarks.description_fa: فرستادن پیام به چند اکتور ثابت
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use a fixed named worker set and compare message counts, not elapsed throughput. Remove benchmark timing harness and audit actor exit.

benchmarks.name: Swapper
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Source effects are logs and hidden behavior stack. Add an explicit observable protocol/state or log oracle; cannot claim meaningful state validation from the current scalar extractor alone.

benchmarks.name: Hot-Swap Actor
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract local class; wrap string commands as a finite protocol. Preserve behavior transitions; instrument all active Receive methods or use a validated explicit mode representation.

benchmarks.name: Redirect Relay
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract RedirectActor only. Its ! send changes sender to relay; do not replace with forward. Exclude GetLicense, routing pools, and performance code from the same file.

benchmarks.name: Speed Threshold Filter
benchmarks.description_fa: عبور پیام فقط بالاتر از حد
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Fixed source/filter/sink; use tiny licence domain. Extract SpeedFilter without unrelated routing/performance code; compare absent sends through post-mailboxes, not a wall-clock timeout.

benchmarks.name: License Validity Filter
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Finite String support or documented bijective symbol encoding is required. Do not silently change string predicates to arbitrary integers.

benchmarks.name: Two-Stage Filter Pipeline
benchmarks.description_fa: عبور از دو شرط پشت سر هم
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: New benchmark composition of two existing source classes, not a separately published standalone program. Explicit source provenance and finite payload domain.

benchmarks.name: Producer/Consumer Roles
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: consumer requests GiveMeThings; producer sends Give
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract untimed receive-orElse snippet only. ActorRef messages/Any payloads need fixed role mapping. Consumer logs must be replaced by a declared observation or captured separately.

benchmarks.name: Thread Ring
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Unroll actor array into three named bootstrap declarations; configure neighbors before Start and keep topology frozen. Neighbor setup ActorRef payloads need adapter.

benchmarks.name: Big All-to-All
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Freeze all actor refs at bootstrap. Move random routing decisions into reproducible inputs or preserve a specified PRNG exactly; seed alone across different languages is insufficient.

benchmarks.name: Fixed Round-Robin Routing
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use fixed ActorRef routees; no resizer, deathwatch replacement, or pool creation after release. The documented Master Terminated handler spawns replacements and is excluded. Built-in routing internals need a verified adapter, or label an explicit router rewrite DERIVED.

benchmarks.name: Fixed Broadcast Routing
benchmarks.description_fa: ارسال هر پیام به همه گیرنده‌ها
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: one request -> each of 3 workers once
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use a static routee set and no pool resizer/replacement. Built-in Router internals are not automatically supported by the existing extractor; explicit actor implementation is a derived benchmark.

benchmarks.name: Consistent-Hash Cache Routing
benchmarks.description_fa: رسیدن کلید یکسان به cache یکسان
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: key affinity, routing hash and cache state
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: put/get same key across 3 fixed caches
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Replace pool bootstrap with fixed refs only after proving routing consistency. Hash ring, key encoding and hidden library state must be modeled exactly; modulo routing is not an equivalent substitute.

benchmarks.name: Lookup Publish/Subscribe
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: fixed subscriptions; publish one matching and one other topic
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. EventBus is not an Actor. Existing tool cannot treat its synchronous publish/subscribe calls as actor handlers; need an adapter preserving sender=noSender and observation cuts. An explicit broker rewrite is DERIVED.

benchmarks.name: Hierarchical Publish/Subscribe
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: subscribe a and ab; publish abc
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Same EventBus boundary issue as lookup; finite topic hierarchy and exact subscription matching. Do not silently turn synchronous library behavior into asynchronous broker semantics.

benchmarks.name: Predicate Publish/Subscribe
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Source predicate is String.length <= classifier. Preserve length operation and sender behavior; requires external-library adapter or separately labeled actor-based derivative.

benchmarks.name: Content-Based Speed Router
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Extract routing predicate with fixed endpoints; source Pool and GetLicense are not admitted. Embedding library RoutingLogic in an explicit Actor is a derived benchmark, not unchanged source.

benchmarks.name: Switchable Router
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use fixed normal/cleanup sinks. Instrument on/off Receive methods or validate explicit scalar mode rewrite; no creation is needed when switching existing destinations.

benchmarks.name: Envelope Enrichment
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Select a constant pure addHeaders function. Do NOT use EnvelopingActorApp, whose header includes currentTimeMillis. Generic nested payloads/maps need finite serialization and projection.

benchmarks.name: Correlation Join
benchmarks.description_fa: جمع‌کردن دو پاسخ دارای شناسه یکسان
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: interleaved ids and first/second reply state
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: A1, B1, A2, B2 -> joins A and B
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Fixed workers and gather actor; finite correlation-id/value domain. Map, Seq, and pending values must be fully observed or encoded with justified bounds; do not model a timeout.

benchmarks.name: Ticket Seller
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use one precreated seller, not BoxOffice (creates event sellers). Vector/Option/nested messages and event metadata need mapping. Exclude Cancel initially or specify PoisonPill/dead-letter semantics explicitly.

benchmarks.name: Bounded Producer-Consumer
benchmarks.description_fa: تولید و مصرف با بافر محدود
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Move all constructor-created children to named bootstrap declarations. Queue contents matter, not just scalar size. Select Savina asynchronous version, not Bita ask/Await examples.

benchmarks.name: Concurrent Dictionary
benchmarks.description_fa: خواندن و نوشتن چند client روی دیکشنری
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Fixed dictionary/workers; externalize workload PRNG; preserve finite key/value map exactly. It is a single server's private map, not shared mutable state between actors.

benchmarks.name: Concurrent Sorted List
benchmarks.description_fa: درج و جست‌وجوی هم‌زمان در فهرست مرتب
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Fixed actors; the data structure allocates ordinary list nodes, not actors. Bound list length and preserve multiplicity/order; full projection or equivalent finite representation required.

benchmarks.name: Chameneos
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Flatten constructor-created participants into fixed named actors. Enum colors may use a bijective int representation. Explicitly model ActorRef payloads and small round bound.

benchmarks.name: Dining Philosophers / Arbitrator
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Choose Savina's untimed arbitrator variant, not Dining Hakkers timers. Remove only shared AtomicLong performance instrumentation or replace it with an actor observer; fork ownership is private arbitrator state. Prove any reduction preserves protocol behavior.

benchmarks.name: Cigarette Smokers
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Inspect helper: busyWait is a bounded computation loop, not a clock/deadline. It calls Math.random with discarded result; externalize random smoker choices. If retaining standard smoke-resource semantics is required, note this source is an instantaneous-acquisition variant.

benchmarks.name: Distributed Single-Source Shortest Path
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Create vertices at bootstrap; AddNeighbor only during setup and then freeze graph. ActorRef keys/parent need fixed IDs and full map projection. Node allocation is not dynamic actor creation here.

benchmarks.name: Capture-Based Leader Election
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: 3 fixed nodes; explicit Init and Start; no physical failures
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: The source explicitly says BUGGY. Use as a known-bug/translation subject, never an automatically correct reference. Exclude Simulator's failure/reinitialization scenario and unused timeout imports; preserve source bug for translation comparison.

benchmarks.name: Asynchronous Bank Transactions
benchmarks.description_fa: انتقال مبلغ و انتظار پاسخ حساب
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. ManualStash variant avoids timed ask/Await, but Double balances, pending-message lists and ActorRef fields need support. Source generator requires at least 10 accounts because of integer division; do not blindly reduce to 2.

benchmarks.name: Logistic Map Series
benchmarks.description_fa: محاسبه مرحله‌ای با درخواست و پاسخ
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Fixed bootstrap; use manual asynchronous version, not Await version. Double arithmetic equality, mutable one-element arrays and private pending queue require defined observation/numeric semantics.

benchmarks.name: Radix Sort Pipeline
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Unroll setup-created pipeline; feed explicit value inputs instead of language-specific PRNG. Preserve Long/Int widths and emitted value order; compare output values, not just success prints.

benchmarks.name: Bitonic Sorting Network
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Source creates topology recursively in constructors. Prove fixed finite network, then declare every node before release; not admitted unchanged by static extractor. Keep array bounds, comparator direction and stage order.

benchmarks.name: All-Pairs Shortest Path
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: phase barriers and distributed matrix updates
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Fixed block graph; flatten startup loops into named actors. Matrix/array messages require deep-copy/immutability audit and complete bounded state projection.

benchmarks.name: Single-Actor Fibonacci
benchmarks.description_fa: محاسبه فیبوناچی داخل یک اکتور ثابت
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: recursive handler computation without actor creation
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: This is NOT Savina recursive actor Fibonacci. The selected class recursively calls an ordinary Scala method and creates no actors. Exclude App's ask/Await/Timeout; use a fixed requester and tell replies. Preserve recursion or validate bounded translation; restrict n to 0..8.

benchmarks.name: Batched Key-Value Requests
benchmarks.description_fa: اجرای چند درخواست در یک پیام دسته‌ای
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: batch atomicity, per-item reply and missing key
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use local precreated db/clients, no remoting/client FSM. Preserve that List requests run inside ONE handler; splitting a batch into separate mailbox messages changes semantics. Object/List/String/Status/ActorRef reply fields need complete finite encoding.

benchmarks.name: N-Queens / FIFO Variant
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: partial solution propagation and result count
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Use non-priority implementation; search recursion is task recursion, not necessarily actor creation. Preserve board payload and stop criterion; choose tiny task bound and audit aliasing.

benchmarks.name: Trapezoidal Integration
benchmarks.description_fa: تقسیم محاسبه عددی و جمع جواب‌ها
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. No protocol time; Double/transcendental math is the blocker. Do not replace with integer arithmetic and call it unchanged. Require a common numerical contract and supported argument generation.

benchmarks.name: Precise Pi Computation
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: 2 fixed workers; low precision after source validation
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. BigDecimal is not a supported scalar of the current fuzzer/observations. Needs explicit decimal representation and arithmetic verification; no claim it runs in v1.11.1.

benchmarks.name: Untimed Inventory FSM
benchmarks.description_fa: درخواست کالا، تأمین و اتمام موجودی
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: pending queue, replenishment and sold-out branch
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: finite stock; concurrent BookRequest; Publisher replies
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Select only the first untimed Inventory class and Publisher. Same file also contains InventoryWithTimer; exclude it entirely. FSM state and pending requests need full observation and supported transformation.

benchmarks.name: Routing Slip / Car Assembly
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: variable route over fixed actors and payload enrichment
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: fixed color/navigation/sensor actors; orders with 2 option sets
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: Precreate fixed component actors and inject refs. Choosing a path through existing actors is not creating actors; if dynamic topology is also forbidden, fix the finite allowed route set explicitly. Seq[ActorRef]/nested messages need bounded representation.

benchmarks.name: Open-Write-Close Stash Protocol
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: stash release order and behavior stack
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: write before open; open; write; close
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Stash is a second private queue, not the ordinary mailbox. Existing complete-post-mailbox comparison does not establish stash equivalence; source is only a protocol snippet, not a real file service.

benchmarks.name: Pausable Worker
benchmarks.description_fa: یک کار در لحظه و ادامه با پیام Ready
benchmarks.count_note: Design estimate, not measured source count; topology audit required.
benchmarks.semantic_focus: backpressure, sender authentication and FIFO unstash
benchmarks.proposed_smoke_scenario: Work(1), Work(2), bogus Ready, worker Ready
benchmarks.adaptation_and_risks: RESERVE. Preserve stash and behavior stack; use an explicit untimed worker, not original HardWorker's artificial delay. Selecting a replacement worker yields a documented benchmark composition, not the complete original app.

exclusions.name: Savina actor-recursive Fibonacci
exclusions.reason: creates two child actors while handling Request. ACSU-42 deliberately uses another, single-actor Fibonacci implementation.

exclusions.name: Savina Quicksort
exclusions.reason: creates left/right actors during Sort handling.

exclusions.name: Savina Sieve
exclusions.reason: creates next filter when a new prime arrives.

exclusions.name: Savina Facility Location
exclusions.reason: creates quadrant children as data arrives.

exclusions.name: Savina UCT
exclusions.reason: grows actor topology during processing; Renaissance akka-uct is not automatically an eligible replacement.

exclusions.name: Savina Sleeping Barber
exclusions.reason: customer factory creates customer actors at runtime.

exclusions.name: Savina SOR
exclusions.reason: SorBootMessage invokes boot that creates grid actors; not admitted as-is.

exclusions.name: Savina FilterBank
exclusions.reason: main explicitly warns its Akka implementation deadlocks and needs debugging; not a known-good baseline.

exclusions.name: Savina timed Await banking
exclusions.reason: timed ask and Await inside application handler; ManualStash version alone is reserved.

exclusions.name: Savina priority search
exclusions.reason: priority mailbox does not match the stipulated Core Rebeca FIFO contract.

exclusions.name: Savina matrix multiplication
exclusions.reason: workers mutate shared MatMulConfig.C; violates no-shared-state assumptions. Local-array rewrite would be a DIFFERENT derived benchmark.

exclusions.name: Savina guided search
exclusions.reason: workers mutate shared graph parent state via setParent; excluded from pure-actor roster.

exclusions.name: Bita LoadBalancer
exclusions.reason: on-demand worker creation and Thread.sleep.

exclusions.name: Bita ProcessRegistry
exclusions.reason: monitor creation during requests and timed ask/Await.

exclusions.name: Bita Messenger
exclusions.reason: timed ask/Await in client handlers; not admitted unchanged.

exclusions.name: Bita SantaClaus
exclusions.reason: timed ask/Await in secretary coordination.

exclusions.name: Akka in Action timed Inventory
exclusions.reason: InventoryWithTimer has a state timeout; only Inventory + Publisher selected.

exclusions.name: Akka in Action GetLicense / performance router
exclusions.reason: Thread.sleep/serviceTime logic; only named untimed classes selected.

exclusions.name: Cookbook envelope app
exclusions.reason: application adds currentTimeMillis header; only constant-header EnvelopingActor kernel selected.

exclusions.name: Learning Akka Chatroom
exclusions.reason: receive only handles joins; posting is unimplemented, so not a complete chat benchmark.

exclusions.name: Rock the JVM current akka-essentials
exclusions.reason: Inspected current files use akka.actor.typed; not Classic.

exclusions.name: Dining Hakkers official sample
exclusions.reason: Timers/schedules for eating and thinking; untimed Savina arbitrator is a separate implementation.

exclusions.name: Scatter-gather-first-completed and tail-chopping
exclusions.reason: Timing via within/interval is semantic; removing it creates another benchmark.

exclusions.name: Timed Ticket Service
exclusions.reason: Timed Rebeca reference is not an untimed Akka Classic example.
